title: Read a document
summary: Read the document body and its question answers.
purpose: Read the document body and its question answers.
request: {{route:document.read}}. For the stored path, use {{route:document.path}}. For a bounded read, see `documents/partial`.
response: Check `content_state` for body availability. `A: null` in `answers` means unanswered. Read answers for referenced documents from those documents.
errors: If the body is unavailable, see `documents/unreadable`.
